body.label: Target
body.html: An area or group within weapon range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose a 3-unit line within weapon range. Compare this Action against each creature in the line. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage.

surges.html: For each creature you also targeted with your previous Ballistics Action this turn, deal +1 weapon damage to that creature.
Ignore 1 Defense granted by equipment or cover for this Action.

rider.title: SALVO
rider.html: If your Locked target is affected, increase the area or line by 1 unit after choosing its origin.
